meta.name: gstack-devex-review
meta.description: GStack developer-experience review for implemented repositories and workflows, focused on setup friction, command reliability, docs gaps, and maintainability.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查仓库与工作流的开发者体验问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责团队仓库的开发者体验与维护性
copy.tagline_en: Review developer experience for repositories and workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you oversee developer experience and maintainability of team repos

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会审查已有代码仓库和开发工作流，找出设置麻烦、命令不稳定、文档缺失和维护困难等问题，并给出改进建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求审查开发体验，或提到设置命令不稳定、文档需要检查时触发。

say.text: 请审查这个仓库的开发体验。
say.note: Claude 会分析仓库并输出发现。

say.text: 检查一下我的设置命令是否可靠。
say.note: Claude 会评估命令稳定性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reviews existing code repositories and developer workflows, identifying setup friction, unreliable commands, documentation gaps, and maintainability issues, then provides improvement suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a developer experience review, or mentions unstable setup commands or documentation quality checks.

say_en.text: Review the developer experience of this repository.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and output findings.

say_en.text: Check if my setup commands are reliable.
